info.prompt: First-person POV through a cracked visor displaying real-time biometrics, the game world rendered in {x-ray blues|neon autopsy yellows}, watching as a rival player's three-territory Domain activates and sends synaptic lightning arcing across the board's bone lattice framework, the resulting camera shake blurring the {hacker overlay text|pulsing streak meter} into illegible glowing streaks.
